name: Haters
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of haters, describing those who oppose the righteous without cause and often in great number, as seen in Psalms where enemies wrongfully seek to destroy the faithful. The Bible warns against provoking scorners, yet calls believers to respond with love and goodness toward those who hate them, reflecting Christ's teaching in Luke. It reveals the spiritual source of hatred in John, identifying the devil as the father of lies and opposition to truth. Despite opposition, God’s favor protects His people, and His plans for them are of peace and hope, assuring believers of ultimate victory over their enemies.
